summary: Master CRM Data Analytics with our comprehensive training course. Gain insights into customer behavior and improve your decision-making skills.
lede: CRM data analytics helps professionals responsible for customer data and sales or marketing performance turn customer interactions into useful business insights. This training addresses fragmented CRM data through quality audits, RFM-based behavioral segmentation, lead scoring and churn analysis, and executive reporting to support campaign and sales decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals who manage customer data and are responsible for driving measurable improvements in sales and marketing performance.
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or Dynamics 365) and basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables and VLOOKUP). No prior coding or SQL experience is required, though familiarity with data concepts is beneficial.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
